camel_example: aliyun iot ClearDeviceDesiredProperty --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot-2w0000' --Identifies.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Clears the desired property values that have been set for a device
description_zh: 调用该接口清空设备已设置的期望属性值
kebab_example: aliyun iot clear-device-desired-property --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --identifies example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ClearDeviceDesiredProperty

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs whose desired property values you want to clear.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要清空期望属性值的设备所属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the device whose desired property values you want to clear.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
要清空期望属性值的设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device whose desired property values you want to clear. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
IotId is a globally unique identifier for the device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要清空期望属性值的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The list of property identifiers whose desired property values you want to clear. You can specify up to 10 property identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 要清空期望属性值的属性标识符列表。属性标识符个数不能超过10个
parameters.name: identifies

Versions.description_zh: 本次清空期望属性值后，对应属性的期望属性值的最新版本号

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
